task: Implement an opt-in DONE-required full-test validation gate from B-3321.
outcome: When a self-host story reaches DONE without fresh DONE-required build-plus-root-test evidence, the terminal shows a failing done-required-validation row with a direct done_required_validate command hint; after running that command, DONE shows the row passing separately from ordinary test-evidence.
facts: B-3321 accepted docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md as the requirements source.
Current lattice validate reads validate.commands first and writes ordinary test-evidence.json.
DONE currently consumes test-evidence.json in packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts.
Decision chose top-level doneRequiredCommands, a separate done-required-evidence.json artifact, and a new done_required_validate command.
Self-host config will opt in with packages/main build before root npm test.
External projects without doneRequiredCommands stay advisory and do not block DONE.
constraints: Do not append root npm test to ordinary validate.commands as the solution.
Do not force external projects to run root npm test by default.
Do not change release_approve_push or .githooks/pre-push behavior in this story.
Evidence must bind to headHash, materialHash, storyFilesHash, policyHash, and commandSetHash.
Gate-consumed facts must be registered in process-fact registry, levels, and contract verifier.
Future implementation review requires 3 rounds x 2 hosts over final material hash.
